option_relations.rationale: Squamous cell carcinoma is a broad category that encompasses various subtypes, including those that could present with the described clinical and pathological features.
Inverted papilloma is a specific type of tumor that matches the description provided in the vignette, particularly with its characteristic downward papillomatous proliferation.
Malignant hidradenoma (hidradenocarcinoma) is directly related to the initial diagnosis of solid and cystic hidradenoma, considering the recurrence and malignant transformation.
Nonkeratinizing squamous cell carcinoma of the nasal mucosa with Schneiderian features matches the clinical presentation and pathological findings described.
